input.content: Can you tell me more about the pydantic/pydantic-ai repo? Keep your answer short

input.arguments: {"repoName":"pydantic/pydantic-ai","question":"Provide a brief summary of the repository, including purpose, main features, and status."}
input.name: ask_question

content.text:
Pydantic AI is a Python agent framework for building production-grade AI apps with:

• Type-safe agents (generic Agent[Deps, Output] + Pydantic validation)  
• Model-agnostic support (15+ LLM providers via a unified Model interface)  
• Structured outputs (automatic Pydantic validation & self-correction)  
• Observability (OpenTelemetry + Logfire tracing, token/cost monitoring)  
• Production tooling (decorator-driven tool system, graph execution engine, evaluation framework, CLI)  

It’s a UV-workspace monorepo (core packages, evals, graph engine, examples, CLI), supports Python 3.10–3.13, and is actively maintained under an open-source license.
